signatures.name: queries_computer_name
signatures.description: Queries computer hostname

signatures.description: Queries the username

signatures.name: queries_keyboard_layout
signatures.description: Queries the keyboard layout

signatures.name: antidebug_setunhandledexceptionfilter
signatures.description: SetUnhandledExceptionFilter detected (possible anti-debug)

signatures.name: stealth_timeout
signatures.description: Possible date expiration check, exits too soon after checking local time

signatures.name: language_check_registry
signatures.description: Checks system language via registry key (possible geofencing)

signatures.name: privilege_elevation_check
signatures.description: Queries process token information to check for Administrator privileges or UAC elevation status

signatures.name: query_fips_reconnaissance
signatures.description: Queried the FIPS cryptography policy, can be used to adapt C2 network encryption or by legitimate encryption software

signatures.name: encrypted_ioc
signatures.description: At least one IP Address, Domain, or File Name was found in a crypto call

signatures.name: registers_vectored_exception_handler
signatures.description: Registers a vectored exception handler (VEH), possibly to hijack execution flow

signatures.name: creates_suspended_process
signatures.description: Creates a process in a suspended state, likely for injection

signatures.name: resumethread_remote_process
signatures.description: Resumed a thread in another process

signatures.name: injection_write_process
signatures.description: Writes to the memory another process

signatures.name: reads_memory_remote_process
signatures.description: Reads from the memory of another process

signatures.name: network_connection_via_suspicious_process
signatures.description: Attempts to make a network connection via suspicious process

signatures.name: terminates_remote_process
signatures.description: Terminates another process

signatures.name: network_cnc_http
signatures.description: HTTP traffic contains suspicious features which may be indicative of malware related traffic

signatures.name: network_http
signatures.description: Performs some HTTP requests

signatures.name: pe_tls_callbacks
signatures.description: The PE file contains TLS callbacks which execute before the entry point and before debugger attachment, commonly used by packers for anti-analysis or pre-EP decryption

signatures.name: dropper
signatures.description: Drops a binary and executes it

signatures.name: injection_rwx
signatures.description: Creates RWX memory

signatures.name: suspicious_tld
signatures.description: Resolves a suspicious Top Level Domain (TLD)

signatures.name: uses_windows_utilities
signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic functionality

signatures.name: antivm_wmi
signatures.description: Executes WMI queries that can be used for anti-virtualization

signatures.name: amsi_enumeration
signatures.description: Enumerated Anti-Malware Scan Interface (AMSI) providers, a potential precursor to AMSI bypass or EDR unhooking

signatures.name: dotnet_code_compile
signatures.description: Compiles .NET code into an executable and executes it

signatures.name: creates_largekey
signatures.description: Creates or sets a registry key to a long series of bytes, possibly to store a binary or malware config

signatures.name: exception_driven_execution
signatures.description: Registered a Vectored Exception Handler (VEH) and intentionally triggered exceptions or manipulated thread contexts. May be used to hijack the OS error dispatcher to execute a payload or shellcode

signatures.name: injection_write_exe_process
signatures.description: Writes an executable to the memory of another process

signatures.name: unbacked_process_mitigation_alteration
signatures.description: Manipulated process mitigation policies (CFG/DEP) from dynamically allocated (unbacked) memory

signatures.name: unbacked_api_resolution
signatures.description: Manually resolves API addresses from dynamically allocated (unbacked) memory, indicative of shellcode or an unpacker

signatures.name: unbacked_library_load
signatures.description: Loads a new DLL where the caller address originates from dynamically allocated (unbacked) memory

signatures.name: unbacked_memory_protection_alteration
signatures.description: Altered memory protections from dynamically allocated (unbacked) memory, indicative of self-modifying shellcode or memory patching

signatures.name: unbacked_crypto_operations
signatures.description: Invoked native Windows cryptographic APIs from dynamically allocated (unbacked) memory, possible encryption/decryption of payloads, c2, files or data

signatures.name: unbacked_delay_execution
signatures.description: Paused execution (sleep/delay) in a thread executing in dynamically allocated (unbacked) memory, indicative of sandbox evasion or C2 sleeping between callbacks

signatures.name: unbacked_process_enumeration
signatures.description: Attempted to enumerate running processes from dynamically allocated (unbacked) memory

signatures.name: unbacked_token_manipulation
signatures.description: Attempted to open, duplicate, or impersonate an access token from dynamically allocated (unbacked) memory, indicative of credential theft or lateral movement

signatures.name: unbacked_memory_network_connection
signatures.description: Network connection initiated from dynamically allocated (unbacked) memory, indicative of fileless C2 activity

signatures.name: persistence_autorun
signatures.description: Installs itself for autorun at Windows startup

signatures.name: network_questionable_http_path
signatures.description: Makes a suspicious HTTP request to a commonly exploitable directory with questionable file ext

signatures.name: pe_deep_entrypoint
signatures.description: The PE entry point is located unusually far into its section, indicative of an appended packer stub

signatures.name: procmem_yara
signatures.description: Yara detections observed in process dumps, payloads or dropped files

signatures.name: static_pe_anomaly
signatures.description: Anomalous binary characteristics

signatures.name: registry_credential_store_access
signatures.description: Accessed credential storage registry keys

signatures.name: deletes_executed_files
signatures.description: Deletes executed files from disk

signatures.name: injection_runpe
signatures.description: Executed a process and injected code into it, probably while unpacking

signatures.name: dotnet_csc_build
signatures.description: Uses csc.exe C# compiler to build and execute code

signatures.name: suspicious_command_tools
signatures.description: Uses suspicious command line tools or Windows utilities

signatures.name: network_ip_exe
signatures.description: Executable is attempted to be downloaded from an IP
